memberdef.name: EepromWrite

briefdescription.para: Writes to the Microchip serial EEPROM connected to the SPI interface.

detaileddescription.para: The function is not designed to be a driver to handle all the conditions of the EEPROM device. The EEPROM contains a 32 byte write buffer which can be filled and then a write is automatically performed by the device. All the data put into the buffer must be in the same page of the device with page boundaries being on 32 byte boundaries.

detaileddescription.para: The test writes and reads data from a Microchip serial EEPROM. This part must be present in the hardware to use this example.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS if successful, XST_DEVICE_NOT_FOUND if the SPI configuration is not found, else XST_FAILURE.

The function calls functions which contain loops that may be infinite if interrupts are not working such that it may not return. If the device slave select is not correct and the device is not responding on bus it reads a status of 0xFF for the status register as the bus is pulled up.
